specs.Shooting Modes: Time Lapse, Slow Motion, Fast Motion

features: 【5K ULTRA HD RECORDING】Capture every adventure in impressive detail with 5K video recording and 50MP photo resolution. Whether you're traveling, exploring nature, or creating content, the camera delivers sharp footage and vibrant images for memorable results

【DUAL SCREEN FOR VLOGGING】The dual-screen design includes a front selfie display and a rear viewing screen, making it easy to frame shots, record personal videos, and create engaging vlogs. Perfect for content creators, travelers, and outdoor enthusiasts

【EIS STABILIZATION & WIDE-ANGLE LENS】Built-in Electronic Image Stabilization helps reduce motion blur and camera shake, while the 170° wide-angle lens captures expansive landscapes, action scenes, and group shots with ease

【40M WATERPROOF WITH WIFI CONNECTIVITY】Take your camera underwater with the included waterproof housing rated up to 30 meters. Built-in WiFi connectivity enables convenient smartphone control and quick sharing of photos and videos

【VERSATILE COMPATIBILITY】Compatible with Android smartphones, iPhones, tablets, tripods, selfie sticks, helmet mounts, bicycle mounts, and motorcycle mounts, making it suitable for travel, cycling, motorcycling, diving, hiking, and adventure recording
